description: This file contains a report implementation for sales partner transaction summaries in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data entries, and build query conditions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, returning columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on the provided filters.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches report data entries from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions dynamically based on filters.
